headline: Paddy Procurement Begins in Kurukshetra from Today; Option to Sell Crop in Other Districts Also Closed; Farmers' Troubles Increase
summary: Government paddy procurement has begun in Kurukshetra. A ban on selling paddy in markets of other districts has limited farmers' options for selling their crop.
why: Paddy is unmilled rice, and government procurement prices and sales rules shape farm incomes and rice supply in India.
